page.overview:
Who is 30329 My First Giraffe?

The set includes 5 pieces which are used to build a giraffe. The first piece is a Bright Yellow 2x4x2 inside bow, which serves as the body and the leg. The second piece is a 2x2 Flame Yellowish Orange brick, which goes on top of the front half of the inside bow. Above that is a Bright Yellow 2x2 brick, and then another 2x2 Flame Yellowish Orange brick. These three pieces serve as the neck. The final piece is a 2x3x2 Bright Yellow outside bow that is attached to the top of the third 2x2 brick and sticks outward. On the side there is a giraffe's face printed.
